title: PRISMM-BENCH: A BENCHMARK OF PEER-REVIEW GROUNDED MULTIMODAL INCONSISTENCIES

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the extent to which Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) rely on linguistic shortcuts, surface-level patterns, and answer phrasing in multiple-choice questions instead of multimodal reasoning. This is measured by testing model accuracy on the benchmark questions without providing the necessary visual or document context (blind evaluation) and calculating a 'Visual Reliance Ratio'. The study also compares performance using natural language answer options versus structured JSON representations to analyze and mitigate these linguistic priors.
